# Maine Private Wells Near Landfills & DoD Sites

<!-- Generated by src/engine/queries/catalog.test.ts from src/constants/prebuiltQueries.ts. Do not edit by hand: run `npm test -- -u`. -->

> Locate Maine private wells (MGS) within proximity of Solid Waste Landfills (NAICS 562212) and National Security / DoD facilities (NAICS 928110) statewide. These are the two facility classes most often implicated in Maine PFAS investigations.

**ID**: `wells-near-landfill-dod-maine`, one of the dashboard questions.

## Analysis question

| Part | Configuration |
| --- | --- |
| **Block A** | wells, in state 23 |
| **Relationship** | Near (1 hop) |
| **Block C** | facilities, NAICS 562212 (Solid Waste Landfill), 928110 (National Security) |

As the engine plans it today. Where a step receives identifiers from an earlier step, they appear
as `http://example.org/...` placeholders. The shared PREFIX block is left out; see
[docs/QUERIES.md](../QUERIES.md#prefixes).

## SPARQL

### Step 1: Finding wells near facilities

```sparql
SELECT DISTINCT (?wellC AS ?iri) WHERE {
  ?s2anchor rdf:type kwg-ont:S2Cell_Level13 .

  ?s2anchor kwg-ont:sfContains ?facilityA .
  ?facilityA fio:ofIndustry ?industryCodeA .
  ?industryCodeA a naics:NAICS-IndustryCode .
  VALUES ?selectedIndustryA { naics:NAICS-562212 naics:NAICS-928110 }
  FILTER(?industryCodeA = ?selectedIndustryA || EXISTS { ?industryCodeA fio:subcodeOf ?selectedIndustryA })

  ?s2anchor kwg-ont:sfTouches | owl:sameAs ?s2target .
  ?s2target rdf:type kwg-ont:S2Cell_Level13 .
  ?s2target spatial:connectedTo kwgr:administrativeRegion.USA.23 .
  ?s2target spatial:connectedTo ?wellC .
  { ?wellC rdf:type il_isgs:ISGS-Well } UNION { ?wellC rdf:type me_mgs:MGS-Well }
}
```

### Step 2: Finding facilities with wells near them

```sparql
SELECT DISTINCT (?facilityA AS ?iri) WHERE {
  ?s2anchor rdf:type kwg-ont:S2Cell_Level13 .

  ?s2anchor kwg-ont:sfContains ?facilityA .
  ?facilityA fio:ofIndustry ?industryCodeA .
  ?industryCodeA a naics:NAICS-IndustryCode .
  VALUES ?selectedIndustryA { naics:NAICS-562212 naics:NAICS-928110 }
  FILTER(?industryCodeA = ?selectedIndustryA || EXISTS { ?industryCodeA fio:subcodeOf ?selectedIndustryA })

  ?s2anchor kwg-ont:sfTouches | owl:sameAs ?s2target .
  ?s2target rdf:type kwg-ont:S2Cell_Level13 .
  ?s2target spatial:connectedTo kwgr:administrativeRegion.USA.23 .
  ?s2target spatial:connectedTo ?wellC .
  { ?wellC rdf:type il_isgs:ISGS-Well } UNION { ?wellC rdf:type me_mgs:MGS-Well }
}
```

### Step 3: Loading details for wells

```sparql
SELECT DISTINCT
  (?wellC AS ?well) ?wellWKT (?s2target AS ?s2cell)
  ?wellName ?meUse ?meWellType ?meDepth ?meOverburden
  ?ilOwner ?ilDepth ?ilPurpose ?ilYield
WHERE {
  ?s2anchor rdf:type kwg-ont:S2Cell_Level13 .

  ?s2anchor kwg-ont:sfContains ?facilityA .
  ?facilityA fio:ofIndustry ?industryCodeA .
  ?industryCodeA a naics:NAICS-IndustryCode .
  VALUES ?selectedIndustryA { naics:NAICS-562212 naics:NAICS-928110 }
  FILTER(?industryCodeA = ?selectedIndustryA || EXISTS { ?industryCodeA fio:subcodeOf ?selectedIndustryA })

  ?s2anchor kwg-ont:sfTouches | owl:sameAs ?s2target .
  ?s2target rdf:type kwg-ont:S2Cell_Level13 .
  ?s2target spatial:connectedTo kwgr:administrativeRegion.USA.23 .
  ?s2target spatial:connectedTo ?wellC .
  { ?wellC rdf:type il_isgs:ISGS-Well } UNION { ?wellC rdf:type me_mgs:MGS-Well }
  ?wellC geo:hasGeometry/geo:asWKT ?wellWKT .
  OPTIONAL { ?wellC rdfs:label ?wellName . }
  OPTIONAL { ?wellC me_mgs:hasUse ?meUse . }
  OPTIONAL { ?wellC me_mgs:ofWellType ?meWellType . }
  OPTIONAL { ?wellC me_mgs:wellDepth/qudt:numericValue ?meDepth . }
  OPTIONAL { ?wellC me_mgs:wellOverburden/qudt:numericValue ?meOverburden . }
  OPTIONAL { ?wellC il_isgs:hasOwner ?ilOwner . }
  OPTIONAL { ?wellC il_isgs:wellDepth/qudt:numericValue ?ilDepth . }
  OPTIONAL { ?wellC il_isgs:wellPurpose ?ilPurpose . }
  OPTIONAL { ?wellC il_isgs:wellYield/qudt:numericValue ?ilYield . }
}
```

### Step 4: Loading details for facilities

```sparql
SELECT DISTINCT ?facility ?facWKT ?facilityName ?industryCode ?industryName ?s2cell WHERE {
  VALUES ?facility { <http://example.org/anchor/1> <http://example.org/anchor/2> }
  ?s2cell kwg-ont:sfContains ?facility ;
          rdf:type kwg-ont:S2Cell_Level13 .
  ?facility fio:ofIndustry ?industryCode ;
            geo:hasGeometry/geo:asWKT ?facWKT ;
            rdfs:label ?facilityName .
  ?industryCode a naics:NAICS-IndustryCode ;
                rdfs:label ?industryName .
  VALUES ?selectedIndustry { naics:NAICS-562212 naics:NAICS-928110 }
  FILTER(?industryCode = ?selectedIndustry || EXISTS { ?industryCode fio:subcodeOf ?selectedIndustry })

}
```

### Step 5: Loading region boundaries

```sparql
SELECT ?region (SAMPLE(?_name) AS ?regionName) (SAMPLE(?_wkt) AS ?regionWKT) WHERE {
  ?region kwg-ont:administrativePartOf kwgr:administrativeRegion.USA.23 ;
          rdfs:label ?_name ;
          geo:hasGeometry/geo:asWKT ?_wkt .
  FILTER(STRSTARTS(STR(?region), STR(kwgr:)))
} GROUP BY ?region
```
